# pi-glance 0.7.5

Glance now requires **Pi 1.0.0 or newer**. This release removes compatibility code and obsolete tests for older Pi hosts, while preserving existing Glance settings and native editing behavior.

- Read the public `theme.appearance` property directly for light, dark, system and custom themes; remove theme-name probing and the old compatibility adapter.
- Remove the unused `message_update` subscription and forwarding code. Effective output throughput continues to use complete request boundaries and provider-reported usage.
- Retire obsolete compatibility assertions, duplicate chunk-timing tests and historical upgrade instructions. Organize active configuration and runtime tests by behavior.
- Pin development to Pi 1.0.0 and validate Pi 1.0.0 / 1.0.4 on Node 22 / 24 with isolated agent state and real SDK throughput tests.

Configuration schema 15, saved preferences, Text/Sweep activity, all 22 palettes and prompt stash remain available. Node.js 22.19.0 or newer is required; there are no runtime dependencies.

Effective output throughput includes the contribution from [@derekszen](https://github.com/derekszen) in [#7](https://github.com/LinYS77/pi-glance/pull/7).
